items.question: Does Brisklane Messenger keep a copy of my messages on its servers?
items.answer: If you turn on Chat Backup, a copy of your message history is stored in encrypted form on Brisklane servers.

sources.title: Brisklane Messenger - Blocking and reporting contacts
sources.text:
If someone is bothering you on Brisklane Messenger, you can block them. Open your chat with that person, tap their name at the top of the screen and choose Block. You can also block a number that is not saved in your contacts from the same menu.

Once you block a contact, they can no longer call you or send you messages, and they will not see your profile photo, status or last-seen time. Blocking does not remove the person from your phone's address book, and they are not told that you have blocked them. If you are both members of the same group chat, you will still see each other's messages in that group.

To see everyone you have blocked, go to Settings > Privacy > Blocked contacts. Tap a name and choose Unblock to let that person contact you again. You will not receive any calls or messages they attempted while they were blocked.

Reporting
If a contact is sending spam or abusive content, choose Report instead of, or as well as, Block. A report sends the contact's phone number and the reason you selected to the Brisklane safety team, who may restrict or close accounts that break our community rules. You can report a group in the same way from the group's info screen.

sources.title: Brisklane Messenger - Chat Backup and your privacy
sources.text:
Chat Backup helps you keep your conversations when you move to a new phone or reinstall Brisklane Messenger. You can turn it on or off at any time under Settings > Chats > Chat Backup.

If you turn on Chat Backup, a copy of your message history is stored in encrypted form on Brisklane servers. The backup is encrypted with a key created from a backup password that you choose during setup. Brisklane does not keep a copy of that password, so if you forget it we cannot open the backup for you, and you will need to create a new one.

What a backup contains
A backup includes the text of your messages, the names of the group chats you belong to, and the date and time each message was sent or received. Photos, videos and voice notes are added to the backup if you tick Include media during setup.

When backups run
A new backup is made once a day while your phone is charging and connected to Wi-Fi. You can also start a backup at any time by tapping Back up now.

Restoring on a new phone
When you install Brisklane Messenger on a new phone and verify your number, you will be asked whether you want to restore a backup. You will need your backup password. Restoring brings back your chats as they were at the time of the last backup.

Deleting a backup
To delete your backup, open Chat Backup and choose Delete backup. Deleting a backup does not delete any messages that are still on your phone.

sources.title: Brisklane Messenger - Changing your phone number
sources.text:
Your Brisklane Messenger account is linked to your phone number. If you get a new number, use Change number rather than creating a new account, so that you keep your profile, settings and group memberships.

Before you start, make sure the SIM card for your new number is in your phone and can receive text messages or calls. Then go to Settings > Account > Change number, enter your old number and your new number, and tap Next. We will send a six-digit verification code to the new number.

Once the change is complete, your profile photo, name, about text and privacy settings move to the new number. You stay a member of every group you belonged to, and the other members see a short notice in each group saying that your number has changed.

You can also choose whether to tell your individual contacts about the change. Pick All contacts, Contacts I have chats with, or Custom to choose people one by one. Contacts you do not notify will not see your new number until they add it themselves, so we recommend telling anyone you talk to often.

If you no longer have access to your old number, you can still move your account by contacting support from the Help screen in the app, but we may ask you to confirm your identity first.

items.question: Does Fallowmere Bank charge a fee if a card payment takes my balance below zero?
items.answer: If your account has received at least two direct deposits in the past 35 days, card payments that take your balance up to $100 below zero are approved without a fee.

sources.title: Fallowmere Bank - Cushion for your Everyday account
sources.text:
Cushion is a feature of the Fallowmere Everyday account that can help when your balance is running low. There is nothing to apply for, and Cushion does not involve a credit check or affect your credit score.

If your account has received at least two direct deposits in the past 35 days, card payments that take your balance up to $100 below zero are approved without a fee. A direct deposit is an electronic payment of wages, a pension or government benefits made into your account by an employer or other payer. Transfers between your own accounts do not count as direct deposits.

This applies to debit card purchases made in shops, online and over the phone, including subscriptions that renew automatically on your card.

Paying it back
When your balance is below zero, the amount you owe is shown in orange at the top of the Fallowmere app. The next money paid into your account is used to bring your balance back to zero before anything else. We ask you to bring your balance back to at least zero within 30 days.

Keeping track
The Cushion screen in the app shows how far below zero your balance is at any time. We also send a notification each time a card payment takes your balance below zero, so that it never comes as a surprise.

sources.title: Fallowmere Bank - Early Pay
sources.text:
Early Pay can make your wages available up to two days before your payday. It is included with every Fallowmere Everyday account at no extra cost, and it switches on automatically the first time your employer pays you by direct deposit.

How it works
Employers usually send details of a payroll payment to the bank a day or two before the money is due to arrive. When we receive those details for a payment to your account, we make the money available to you straight away instead of waiting for the payment date. You receive the same amount you would otherwise receive on payday.

How early your money arrives depends on when your employer sends the payment details, so it can vary from one payday to the next. If your employer sends the details late, your money will arrive on your usual payday.

Which payments are included
Early Pay works for wages, pensions and government benefits paid by direct deposit. It does not apply to transfers from friends or family, or to payments from your accounts at other banks.

Turning Early Pay off
Some people prefer to receive their wages on the same day each month. You can turn Early Pay off under Account > Early Pay and turn it back on whenever you like.

sources.title: Fallowmere Bank - Lost or stolen cards
sources.text:
If you cannot find your Fallowmere debit card, freeze it straight away in the app by tapping Card > Freeze. A frozen card cannot be used for new purchases or cash withdrawals, but regular payments you have already set up, such as subscriptions, will continue. If you find the card again, tap Unfreeze and it will work as normal.

If you think your card has been stolen, or someone has used it without your permission, report it in the app under Card > Report stolen. This cancels the card permanently, and we will post a replacement to your home address. Replacement cards usually arrive within five to seven business days and have a new card number.

You can add your new card to your phone's wallet as soon as you order the replacement, so you can keep paying while you wait for the plastic card to arrive.

Unrecognised payments
If you see a payment you do not recognise, tap it in your transaction list and choose Report a problem. Our team will contact you within one business day. You will not be held responsible for payments you did not make or authorise, as long as you report them promptly.

items.question: Does Talvery Air charge a fee to change my flight?
items.answer: You can change your flight once without a change fee if you make the change at least 14 days before the original departure date.

sources.title: Talvery Air - Choosing your seat
sources.text:
When you book a Talvery Air flight, you can choose your seat straight away or leave it until later. If you have not chosen a seat by the time you check in, we will assign one to you free of charge, and we will try to seat people on the same booking together.

Seat prices
Standard seats in rows 10 to 30 cost $12 per flight. Seats in rows 3 to 9 are near the front of the cabin, so you can leave the aircraft sooner, and cost $18 per flight. Extra legroom seats in row 1 and the exit rows cost $35 per flight.

Exit rows
To sit in an exit row you must be at least 15 years old, able to lift 15 kg, and willing to help the crew in an emergency. You cannot sit in an exit row if you are travelling with an infant.

Changing your seat
You can change your seat in Manage Booking until check-in closes. If you move to a seat that costs more, you pay the difference. If you move to a cheaper seat, or give up a seat you paid for, the difference is not refunded.

Families
Children under 12 are always seated next to at least one adult on the same booking at no charge, even if nobody on the booking has paid for a seat.

sources.title: Talvery Air - Check-in and boarding
sources.text:
Online check-in opens 24 hours before departure and closes 60 minutes before departure. You can check in on our website or in the Talvery Air app, and keep your boarding pass on your phone or print it at home.

If you prefer to check in at the airport, our desks open three hours before departure and close 45 minutes before departure. You will need to check in at a desk if you need special assistance or are carrying sporting equipment or other items that must be declared.

Bag drop
If you have checked in online and have a bag to check, take it to the bag drop desk before it closes, 45 minutes before departure.

Boarding
Boarding usually starts 40 minutes before departure, and the gate closes 15 minutes before departure. We board by group number, which is printed on your boarding pass. Passengers who need extra time and families with children under 5 are invited to board first.

Identity documents
Bring a valid photo ID that matches the name on your booking. If you are flying abroad, you will need a passport that is valid for the whole of your trip, and any visa your destination requires.

sources.title: Talvery Air - Changing your flight
sources.text:
You can change the date or time of your Talvery Air flight online in Manage Booking, in the Talvery Air app, or by calling our reservations team. Changes made by phone follow the same rules as changes made online.

You can change your flight once without a change fee if you make the change at least 14 days before the original departure date. If your new flight costs more than your original flight, you pay the difference in fare and any extra taxes. If your new flight costs less, we return the difference to you as Talvery travel credit, which is valid for 12 months from the date it is issued.

Who travels on the new flight
Everyone on the same booking must move to the new flight together. If only some of the passengers on a booking want to change, call our reservations team, who can split the booking for you first.

Names on a booking
Tickets cannot be transferred to another person. If a passenger's name is misspelt on a booking, contact us before check-in opens and we will correct it free of charge.

After you change
We will email you a new itinerary as soon as the change is confirmed. Any seats or extra bags you paid for are moved to your new flight where the same options are available.

items.question: Do I pay interest on purchases with my Ostlemark card?
items.answer: Purchases on your Ostlemark card are not charged interest if you pay your statement balance in full by the due date.

sources.title: Ostlemark Card - Earning and using points
sources.text:
Every purchase you make with your Ostlemark credit card earns points. You earn 1 point for every $1 you spend, and 2 points for every $1 spent on flights, hotels and car hire booked directly with the airline, hotel or rental company. Points are added to your account when the purchase is posted, which usually takes one to three business days.

Using your points
You can redeem points in the Ostlemark app once you have 1,000 points or more. Points can be turned into a statement credit at 1 cent per point, transferred to a partner airline loyalty programme, or used to buy gift cards from our partner shops.

Points that are not earned
Points are not earned on cash withdrawals, balance transfers, fees, or payments to gambling websites. If you return an item, the points you earned on it are removed from your account.

Keeping your points
Your points do not expire as long as your account is open. If you close your account, any points you have not redeemed are lost, so remember to use them first.

sources.title: Ostlemark Card - Statements and payment due dates
sources.text:
Your Ostlemark statement is produced on the same date each month. It lists every transaction posted since your last statement and shows your statement balance, your minimum payment and your payment due date. Your payment due date is 25 days after your statement date.

Purchases on your Ostlemark card are not charged interest if you pay your statement balance in full by the due date.

Ways to pay
You can pay from any US bank account in the Ostlemark app, set up an automatic payment, or mail a check. Automatic payments can be set to pay your statement balance, your minimum payment or a fixed amount each month, and they are taken on your due date. Payments made in the app before 8 p.m. Eastern time count as received that day.

Your minimum payment
Your minimum payment is $25 or 1% of your statement balance, whichever is higher. If your statement balance is less than $25, your minimum payment is the full statement balance.

Changing your statement date
You can ask to move your statement date once every 12 months from Settings > Statements. The change takes effect after your next statement, so one statement may cover a shorter or longer period than usual.

sources.title: Ostlemark Card - Authorised users
sources.text:
You can add up to four authorised users to your Ostlemark credit card account. Each authorised user gets their own card with their name on it, and their purchases appear on your statement. You are responsible for paying for everything they spend.

Who can be added
Authorised users must be at least 16 years old. You will need their full name, date of birth and home address. We do not run a credit check on authorised users.

Setting limits
For each authorised user, you can set a monthly spending limit in the app, from $100 up to your own credit limit. You can also turn off cash withdrawals or online purchases for any authorised user's card. Changes take effect straight away.

Points
Points earned on purchases made by authorised users are added to your account, and only you can redeem them.

Removing an authorised user
You can remove an authorised user at any time in the app. Their card stops working immediately. Any purchases they made before you removed them still appear on your statement and must be paid.

items.question: What interest rate do Glenmarrow Savings Vaults pay?
items.answer: On the Premium plan, Savings Vaults earn 3.20% AER on balances up to $50,000.

sources.title: Glenmarrow Money - Setting up a Savings Vault
sources.text:
Savings Vaults let you put money aside inside your Glenmarrow account, separate from the money you spend day to day. You can have up to ten Vaults open at once and give each one a name, an emoji and an optional savings goal.

Creating a Vault
In the app, tap Vaults, then New Vault. Choose a name, set a goal amount and a target date if you want one, and decide how much to move in to start. You can create a Vault with a zero balance and add money later.

Moving money in and out
You can move money between your main balance and any Vault instantly, as often as you like, at no cost. Money in a Vault cannot be spent with your card until you move it back to your main balance.

Round-ups
Turn on Round-ups and every card purchase is rounded up to the nearest dollar, with the spare change moved into the Vault of your choice. For example, a $3.40 coffee moves 60 cents into your Vault.

Closing a Vault
When you close a Vault, the money in it goes straight back to your main balance. You can reopen a closed Vault within 30 days from the Vaults screen.

sources.title: Glenmarrow Money - Sending money abroad
sources.text:
You can send money from your Glenmarrow account to bank accounts in more than 40 countries. Open Payments, choose Send abroad, and enter your recipient's name, bank details and the amount you want to send, either in dollars or in their currency.

Fees and exchange rates
Before you confirm a transfer, the app shows the exchange rate, our fee and exactly how much your recipient will receive. Our fee is 0.6% of the amount you send, with a minimum of $2. There are no hidden charges added to the exchange rate, but your recipient's bank may charge its own fee for receiving the money.

How long it takes
Most transfers arrive within one business day. Transfers to some countries, or transfers that need extra security checks, can take up to five business days. We will tell you the expected arrival date before you confirm.

Limits
You can send up to $10,000 abroad in a single transfer and up to $25,000 in any 30-day period.

Cancelling a transfer
You can cancel a transfer in the app as long as its status still shows Scheduled. Once a transfer shows Sent, it cannot be cancelled.

sources.title: Glenmarrow Money - Premium plan
sources.text:
Glenmarrow Premium is a monthly subscription plan for your Glenmarrow account. It costs $8 per month, taken from your main balance on the same day each month. You can cancel at any time in the app, and Premium stays active until the end of the month you have already paid for.

What Premium includes
- A daily ATM withdrawal limit of $1,500
- Free replacement cards, sent by express delivery
- Priority support through in-app chat, seven days a week
- Travel insurance for trips of up to 31 days

Savings Vaults on Premium
On the Premium plan, Savings Vaults earn 3.20% AER on balances up to $50,000. Interest is calculated on your end-of-day balance and paid into each Vault on the first business day of the following month. The rate is variable, and we will give you at least 30 days' notice before we lower it.

Upgrading
You can upgrade from Account > Plan in the app. Premium starts straight away, and your first monthly fee is taken on the day you upgrade.

Travel insurance
Travel insurance covers you and your partner for medical emergencies, cancelled trips and lost luggage. Details of what is covered, and how to make a claim, are in the policy document in the app.

items.question: Can I bring my dog or cat in the cabin on Merrowind Air?
items.answer: On domestic flights, small dogs and cats can travel in the cabin in a soft-sided carrier that fits under the seat in front of you.

sources.title: Merrowind Air - Pets in the cabin
sources.text:
On domestic flights, small dogs and cats can travel in the cabin in a soft-sided carrier that fits under the seat in front of you. The carrier can be no larger than 45 x 30 x 25 cm, and your pet must stay inside it, with the carrier closed, for the whole flight, including take-off, landing and taxiing.

Adding your pet to a booking
Call our reservations team at least 48 hours before departure to add your pet to your booking. Pets cannot be added in the app or at the airport. The pet fee is $95 for each flight and is paid when your pet is added.

Each passenger can bring one pet carrier. The carrier counts as your personal item, but you can still bring one cabin bag for the overhead locker.

Before you fly
Your pet must be at least 10 weeks old and able to stand up and turn around inside the carrier. Make sure your pet has had a chance to eat, drink and go to the toilet before you leave for the airport. Please check in at the airport desk rather than online, so that our staff can check the carrier and attach a pet tag to it.

On board
You will be seated in a window seat, away from the exit rows. Your pet must not be taken out of the carrier during the flight and must not be given food on board, although small amounts of water are fine.

sources.title: Merrowind Air - Flying with infants
sources.text:
Children under two years old can travel on your lap rather than in their own seat. Each adult can hold one infant on their lap, and the infant must be added to the booking when you book or later in Manage Booking. Infants on your lap travel for 10% of the adult fare, plus taxes.

Infant seats
If you would like your child to have their own seat, you can book a child ticket for them and bring an approved car seat. The car seat must fit in a standard economy seat and carry a label showing it is approved for use in aircraft.

Bassinets
A limited number of bassinets are available on flights longer than four hours, for babies weighing up to 10 kg. Request one by calling our reservations team. Bassinets are given out in the order requests are received.

Strollers and car seats
You can check in one stroller and one car seat for each child at no charge, in addition to your normal baggage allowance. Folding strollers can be left at the aircraft door and returned to you when you get off.

Feeding
You are welcome to bring baby food, formula and milk through security in reasonable quantities for your journey.

sources.title: Merrowind Air - Check-in times
sources.text:
Online check-in for Merrowind Air flights opens 24 hours before departure. You can check in on our website or in the app and keep your boarding pass on your phone.

When check-in closes
For domestic flights, check-in closes 45 minutes before departure. For international flights, check-in closes 60 minutes before departure. These times apply whether you check in online or at the airport desk, and they also apply to bag drop.

Who needs to check in at the desk
You will need to check in at an airport desk if you are travelling with an infant on your lap who is not yet on your booking, or with sporting equipment that must be measured. Desks open three hours before departure.

At the gate
Boarding starts 40 minutes before departure. The gate closes 15 minutes before departure, and we cannot hold the flight for passengers who arrive after this.

Documents
For international flights, bring a passport that is valid for the whole of your trip. We may also need to see your visa or residence permit at check-in.

items.question: How long does Hollicott keep the voice recordings from my speaker?
items.answer: For child profiles, voice recordings are deleted automatically 30 days after they are made.

sources.title: Hollicott Home - Setting up your speaker
sources.text:
To set up a Hollicott speaker you need the Hollicott app on a phone or tablet, a Hollicott account, and a Wi-Fi network that you know the password for.

1. Plug the speaker in. The light ring glows white while it starts up, and then pulses orange when it is ready to be set up.
2. Open the Hollicott app, tap Add device, and choose Speaker. The app will find speakers nearby that are ready to set up.
3. Choose the room the speaker is in, such as Kitchen or Bedroom. This helps when you have more than one speaker.
4. Select your Wi-Fi network and enter the password. The speaker connects and checks for updates, which can take a few minutes.
5. When the light ring turns off, the speaker is ready. Try asking it about the weather to check that everything works.

If setup does not work
Make sure your phone is connected to the same Wi-Fi network you are setting the speaker up on, and that the speaker is within range of your router. If the light ring flashes red, hold the action button for 15 seconds to reset the speaker, then start again.

Adding other people
Anyone in your household can use the speaker. To let them control it from their own phone, invite them from Home > Members in the app.

sources.title: Hollicott Home - Voice recordings and your privacy
sources.text:
A Hollicott speaker starts recording when it hears the wake word, Hey Hollicott, and the light ring turns blue while it is recording. The recording is sent to Hollicott so that we can work out what you asked for and respond.

Voice profiles
Each person in your household can create a voice profile, so that the speaker can tell who is talking and give personal answers, such as reading out their own calendar. A parent or guardian can set up a child profile for a child under 13 from the Family section of the Hollicott app.

For child profiles, voice recordings are deleted automatically 30 days after they are made. The parent or guardian who set up a child profile can listen to that child's recordings in the app and can delete any of them sooner.

Reviewing your recordings
Open the Hollicott app and go to Privacy > Voice history to see a list of requests made on your speakers. You can play back a request, read its transcript and delete it. You can also say Hey Hollicott, delete what I just said, to remove your most recent request.

Muting the microphone
Press the microphone button on top of the speaker to turn the microphone off. The light ring turns red, and the speaker will not respond to the wake word until you press the button again.

Who can hear recordings
Recordings are not shared with advertisers. A small number of recordings may be reviewed by trained Hollicott staff to improve speech recognition if you have turned on Help improve Hollicott in Privacy settings.

sources.title: Hollicott Home - Linking music services
sources.text:
You can play music on your Hollicott speaker from the music services you already use. Open the Hollicott app, go to Settings > Music, tap Link a service, and sign in to your account with that service. Once a service is linked, you can ask for songs, albums, artists, playlists and radio stations by name.

Choosing a default service
If you have linked more than one service, choose a default so the speaker knows where to play from when you do not say. You can still ask for a different service by naming it at the end of your request.

Playing on more than one speaker
Group speakers in the app under Home > Speaker groups, then ask for music on the group's name, such as Downstairs, to play the same music in several rooms at once.

Each household member's own account
If each person in your household has a voice profile, the speaker plays from the music account linked to whoever is speaking. Otherwise it uses the account linked by the person who set up the speaker.

Unlinking a service
To remove a service, go to Settings > Music, choose the service and tap Unlink. Any playlists you made stay in your account with the music service.

items.question: Does Driftmoor charge extra when I pay by card in another currency?
items.answer: Between 1 November 2026 and 31 January 2027, card payments in a foreign currency are converted at the network exchange rate with no Driftmoor markup.

sources.title: Driftmoor - Using your card abroad
sources.text:
Your Driftmoor debit card can be used in shops, restaurants and online wherever the card network's logo is shown, in more than 150 countries. You do not need to tell us before you travel, but please check that your phone number is up to date in the app so that we can reach you if a payment looks unusual.

Between 1 November 2026 and 31 January 2027, card payments in a foreign currency are converted at the network exchange rate with no Driftmoor markup. Each payment appears in your transaction list in the local currency, alongside the amount in US dollars that was taken from your balance.

Pay in the local currency
If a card machine or website asks whether you want to pay in US dollars or in the local currency, choose the local currency. If you choose dollars, the shop's own provider converts the amount, often at a worse rate, and we cannot refund the difference.

Cash abroad
You can withdraw up to $400 a day from cash machines abroad. Some machine operators add their own fee, which should be shown on screen before you confirm the withdrawal.

If your card is lost abroad
Freeze your card straight away in the app. You can keep paying with your phone using your digital card while a replacement is posted to your home address.

sources.title: Driftmoor - Joint accounts
sources.text:
A Driftmoor joint account is shared by two people. Both of you can see every transaction, pay in money, make payments and order a card in your own name. It works well for paying household bills and shared costs.

Opening a joint account
One of you starts the application in the Driftmoor app under Accounts > Open a joint account and invites the other person by phone number. Both of you need a personal Driftmoor account first, and both need to be at least 18 years old. The account opens once the second person accepts the invitation and confirms their identity.

Who is responsible
Each account holder is responsible for the whole balance of a joint account, not just their own spending. If the account goes below zero, we can ask either of you to repay the full amount.

Leaving a joint account
Either person can ask to leave. Before the account can be closed, you will need to agree how to split the remaining balance, and any regular payments will need to be moved to another account. If you cannot agree, the account will be frozen until you do or until we receive a court order.

Notifications
Both of you receive a notification for every payment in or out of the joint account. You can turn these off for yourself without affecting the other person.

sources.title: Driftmoor - Sending money to friends
sources.text:
You can send money instantly to anyone who has a Driftmoor account, using their phone number, their Driftmoor tag or a QR code from their app. Payments between Driftmoor accounts are free and usually arrive within seconds.

Paying someone without Driftmoor
If your friend does not have a Driftmoor account, you can send them a payment link by text message or email. They can collect the money into any US bank account by entering their account details within 7 days. If the link is not used within 7 days, the money is returned to you.

Splitting a bill
After you pay for something with your card, open the transaction and tap Split. Choose who to split it with and whether to split evenly or by amount. Each person receives a request they can pay in one tap.

Requesting money
You can send a request to any Driftmoor user from the Payments screen. Requests that are not paid within 30 days expire automatically.

Limits
You can send up to $2,500 a day to other people. If you need to send more, you can make a bank transfer from the Payments screen instead.

sources.title: Skelvane Air - Cabin bags
sources.text:
Every Skelvane Air passenger can bring one small personal item on board, such as a handbag, laptop bag or small backpack. It must fit under the seat in front of you and be no larger than 40 x 30 x 15 cm.

Cabin bags
You can also bring one cabin bag for the overhead locker, up to 55 x 40 x 20 cm and 10 kg, including handles and wheels. On busy flights, we may ask some passengers to leave their cabin bag at the gate. These bags are labelled and returned to you at the baggage reclaim belt.

Liquids
Liquids in your cabin bag must be in containers of 100 ml or less, packed together in one clear, resealable bag of up to 1 litre. Medicines and baby food needed during the flight are allowed in larger amounts.

Power banks and batteries
Power banks and spare lithium batteries must be carried in your cabin bag or personal item. Each passenger can carry up to two power banks of up to 100 Wh each.

Duty-free shopping
Items bought in the airport after security can be carried on board in addition to your cabin bag, as long as they fit in one shopping bag.

sources.title: Skelvane Air - Checked bags
sources.text:
Checked bags are dropped off at the bag drop desk after you check in online, or at the check-in desk if you check in at the airport. Bag drop closes 45 minutes before departure, and we cannot accept bags after that time.

For travel between 1 December 2026 and 15 January 2027, every Skelvane Air ticket includes one free checked bag of up to 23 kg. The bag can measure up to 158 cm when you add together its length, width and height, including handles and wheels.

Heavy bags
Bags weighing more than 23 kg are accepted up to a maximum of 32 kg, and must have a heavy-bag label attached at the desk so that baggage handlers know to take care when lifting them. No single bag can weigh more than 32 kg.

Sports equipment
Skis, golf clubs and bicycles can be checked in, but they must be packed in a dedicated bag or box. Bicycles must have the pedals removed and the handlebars turned sideways.

What not to pack
Keep valuables, keys, medicines and electronic devices in your cabin bag. Power banks and spare lithium batteries are not allowed in checked bags at all.

sources.title: Skelvane Air - Delayed, damaged or lost bags
sources.text:
If your checked bag does not arrive on the baggage belt, or arrives damaged, go to the Skelvane Air baggage desk in the arrivals hall before you leave the airport. Our staff will make a report and give you a reference number that you can use to track your bag online.

Delayed bags
Most delayed bags are found and delivered to you within 48 hours. We will deliver your bag to your home or hotel free of charge. While you wait, you can buy essential items such as toiletries and a change of clothes, and claim the cost back from us. Keep your receipts.

Damaged bags
If your bag is damaged, report it at the airport if you can, and in any case within 7 days of your flight. We will arrange a repair or, if your bag cannot be repaired, pay you its current value.

Lost bags
If your bag has not been found 21 days after your flight, we treat it as lost. You can then claim for the bag and its contents, up to the limit set by international air travel rules.

Making a claim
Claims can be made online using your reference number. Include your boarding pass, your bag tag and receipts for any items you bought or are claiming for.

sources.text:
When you book a stay on Tarnwell, you see the full price before you confirm, including the nightly rate, any cleaning fee set by the host, taxes, and the Tarnwell service fee. There are no extra charges added at checkout.

Ways to pay
You can pay with a debit or credit card, with Tarnwell credit, or with a combination of the two. We do not accept cash or bank transfers, and you should never pay a host directly outside Tarnwell.

Paying in two parts
For stays booked more than 30 days before check-in, you can choose to pay half now and half later. The second payment is taken automatically from the same card 14 days before check-in, and we will email you three days before we take it.

Currency
Prices are shown in the currency you choose in your account settings. If your card is in a different currency, your bank may apply its own exchange rate or fees.

Receipts
Your receipt is available in the app under Trips as soon as your booking is confirmed. Business travellers can add a company name and tax number to the receipt before downloading it.

sources.title: Tarnwell Stays - Checking in and out
sources.text:
Each listing shows its check-in and check-out times, which are set by the host. Most hosts offer check-in from 3 p.m. and ask guests to check out by 11 a.m.

Getting the keys
Your host's check-in instructions appear in the Tarnwell app under Trips 48 hours before your stay begins. Many listings offer self check-in using a key box or smart lock, with a code that is shown only to you. For other listings, the host or a co-host will meet you to hand over the keys.

Arriving early or late
If you expect to arrive earlier or later than the listed check-in time, message your host through the app as soon as you can. Hosts are not required to offer early check-in, but many will store your luggage if they can.

Before you leave
Follow the host's checkout list, which usually asks you to load the dishwasher, take out the rubbish and lock up. Leave the keys where the host asked you to.

Problems during your stay
If something at the listing is not as described, such as a broken shower or no hot water, report it in the app with photos within 24 hours of finding it. We will work with the host to fix it.

How refunds are paid
Refunds go back to the payment method you used to book. If you paid by card, the refund usually appears on your statement within 5 to 10 business days, depending on your bank. If you paid with Tarnwell credit, the credit is returned to your account straight away. If you used both, each part is refunded to where it came from.

Other guests on the reservation
Only the person who made the booking can cancel it. Other guests you added to the reservation receive an email to let them know the trip has been cancelled, so you do not need to tell them yourself.

During the first 24 hours after booking, you can cancel any Tarnwell reservation for a full refund. A full refund includes the nightly rate, the cleaning fee, taxes and the Tarnwell service fee.

How refunds are paid
Refunds go back to the payment method you used to book. If you paid by card, the refund usually appears on your statement within 5 to 10 business days, depending on your bank. If you paid with Tarnwell credit, the credit is returned to your account straight away. If you used both, each part is refunded to where it came from.

Other guests on the reservation
Only the person who made the booking can cancel it. Other guests you added to the reservation receive an email to let them know the trip has been cancelled, so you do not need to tell them yourself.
